topic: Soil Microbiome Diversity in Agricultural Fields
llm_query: Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from soil samples collected from various agricultural fields. The samples will be collected from different geographic locations and at different times to observe seasonal variations. Environmental descriptors such as soil pH, moisture content, and temperature will be recorded. The soil samples will undergo nucleic acid extraction followed by sequencing to obtain metagenomic data. This data is intended to analyze the diversity and composition of microbial communities in different agricultural settings and how they are influenced by environmental factors.

topic: Aquatic Microbial Ecology in Freshwater Lakes
llm_query: Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from water samples collected from several freshwater lakes. The samples will be gathered from multiple depths and geographic locations during different seasons. Key environmental parameters such as temperature, dissolved oxygen, and nutrient concentrations will be measured. The water samples will be processed for nucleic acid extraction followed by sequencing to generate metagenomic profiles. This data is intended to study the structure and function of microbial communities in freshwater ecosystems and their response to environmental changes.

topic: Airborne Microbial Communities in Urban Environments
llm_query: Hi. I want to create a dataset with a metadata table for data generated from air samples collected in various urban environments. Samples will be taken from different locations and heights, at various times of the day and under different weather conditions. Environmental factors such as air temperature, humidity, and particulate matter concentration will be recorded. The air samples will be subjected to nucleic acid extraction and sequencing to obtain metagenomic data. This data is intended to investigate the diversity and distribution of airborne microbial communities in urban areas and how they correlate with environmental pollution and human activity.
